MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The quick-setting clear epoxies felt useful for small household repairs alongside my recent wall anchors and wood screws.",
    "The single Gorilla syringe suited a modest repair need; ClearWeld also fit that purpose, but I would not buy both for the same task."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts looked related to my fastening purchases, but my recent work uses nails and wood screws rather than bolts that need nuts.",
    "Heat shrink tubing, electronics cleaner, buffing compound, and a precision caliper serve tasks I have not shown a need for, such as wiring, polishing, or precision measuring.",
    "Steel-reinforced epoxy assumes a metal repair, while the safety can and COVID test address needs I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of construction supplies seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when its purpose differed from fastening or mounting.",
    "The vacuum bags and medicine cups seemed to invite broader cleaning and health suggestions, although neither purchase establishes a need for electronics cleaner or a COVID test."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail, wood-screw, and drywall-anchor purchases point more specifically toward fastening wood and mounting household items.",
    "A repair product's material and purpose matter: clear quick-setting adhesive feels relevant, while steel-reinforced adhesive needs a metal repair to justify it.",
    "Two products can suit the same need without both being useful purchases right now; one small adhesive package is enough for me this time."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my household repair needs but stretched them into unrelated workshop, electrical, and health tasks."
}
